rationale: The agent verified identity using full name plus ZIP, matched to a single user. They inspected the user’s orders and correctly identified the two delivered orders containing tablets. The agent then executed the return on the correct order/item ID with the specified payment method, and reported the updated status and refund destination accurately. No actions were taken without confirmation, no unsupported claims were made, and all steps conformed to policy.
